title: GraphSeer: Multimodal Knowledge Graph Relational Image Retrieval with MLLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.29470v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal knowledge graphs (MMKGs) store entities with photos and names and link them by facts. MMKG methods predict links between known entity IDs, and image retrievers, from CLIP to MLLM embedders, return entities that look like a query photo or match its description. Neither answers a common question about a new photo: which graph entity is related to the one shown, such as the team of a pictured player or the city of a landmark. We call this knowledge graph relational image retrieval (KRIR): given a photo and a natural-language relation, retrieve the related MMKG entity, which rarely resembles the photo, whether the depicted entity is in the graph (known) or not (unseen). We build three benchmarks from YAGO, Wikidata and in-the-wild OVEN photos. The task hides two hops: recognising which graph entity is shown, and recalling what it is connected to. translated_title: GraphSeer：基于多模态大语言模型的多模态知识图谱关系图像检索
translated_abstract: 多模态知识图谱（MMKG）以照片和名称存储实体，并通过事实将它们相互链接。现有 MMKG 方法预测已知实体 ID 之间的链接，而图像检索器（从 CLIP 到各类 MLLM 嵌入器）则返回与查询照片相似或符合其描述的实体。然而，两者都无法回答一个关于新照片的常见问题：照片中所示实体与哪个图谱实体相关，例如照片中球员所属的球队，或地标所在的城市。我们将此任务称为知识图谱关系图像检索（KRIR）：给定一张照片和一个自然语言关系，检索相关的 MMKG 实体——该实体通常与照片本身并不相像——且无论照片中描绘的实体是否存在于图谱中（已知）或不存在（未见）。我们基于 YAGO、Wikidata 和真实场景的 OVEN 照片构建了三个基准数据集。该任务隐含两个跳转步骤：识别照片中展示的是哪个图谱实体，并回忆该实体与什么相关联。GraphSeer 在单一多模态大语言模型内部将这两个步骤衔接起来：它将照片与图谱建立链接，并…
tldr: GraphSeer 提出了知识图谱关系图像检索（KRIR）这一新任务——给定照片和自然语言关系检索相关的多模态知识图谱实体，并在单个多模态大语言模型中统一完成“识别照片对应实体”与“推理其关联实体”这两个步骤。
en_tdlr: GraphSeer introduces knowledge graph relational image retrieval (KRIR)—retrieving the MMKG entity related to a query photo given a natural-language relation—and unifies entity recognition and relational reasoning within a single multimodal LLM.
